I really like the products in the store and the service from the lady who works there. Always very friendly and attentive.
It's also the only place where I can find Bravery cat food for my kittens, 5 stars!

I'm only not giving 0 stars because it's impossible.
We called to schedule a bath and grooming for a cocker spaniel, as she had some knots. They asked the dog's weight (9kg), and we left the dog at 4:30 PM. At exactly 7:00 PM, they called and said (come pick her up, because we're about to close). What? They need to know how to work with the public. If they were finishing up, they should have called beforehand, 15/20 minutes, whatever it took to let us know. It's not merchandise; people work, they have lives. I can't just run away, even so, I ordered an Uber and with the traffic I didn't arrive on time. Because of that, they called me every 5 minutes and on my cell phone to make the payment, they told me 38 euros, 10 more than what was quoted!! The problem wasn't the price, but the surprise, especially since we have plenty of money! Terrible service, doesn't know how to talk on the phone, rude. It's 38 euros for terrible service, I wouldn't recommend them to anyone!
Very nice place! They treated my anxious dog Zaya with understanding and did everything to meet all our needs! The dog came back calm and happy, thank you very much! 🩷 …
